goal: Move the batch preflight projection both Host adapters currently duplicate into a new runtime/unattended/batch_preflight.ts, so claim ownership, branch availability, dirty-tree checking, recovery-children reconstruction, plan drift, and HEAD lineage are decided once below the Host boundary, and fix findExistingActiveBatch to filter terminal states.

acceptance.assertion: A new module runtime/unattended/batch_preflight.ts projects claim ownership, batch branch availability, working-tree cleanliness against the authorized scope, reconstructed recovery children, plan digest, and base HEAD from a repository root, initiative slug, resolved branch, and prior persisted batch record. It performs no confirmation, mints no capability, imports no Host SDK, and branches on no Host identity.

Both adapters route through it in this same change: runtime/claude/kernel_ports.ts and .pi-extension/imm-unattended-batch.ts each retain only genuinely Host-specific behavior — their confirmation transport, their failure envelope shape, and their non-interactive refusal form — and neither re-implements a preflight decision. A tree in which only one adapter is migrated fails this acceptance.

findExistingActiveBatch filters terminal states instead of matching any record for the slug, in the single shared implementation that replaces the two identical copies in .pi-extension/runtime-stub.ts and runtime/claude/kernel_ports.ts, so a settled batch is no longer returned as active.

No generic Host registry and no Host-identity branch is introduced inside shared runtime; ADR-0004's rejection stands. The change moves Host-independent pure functions to the layer that already owns batch state and nothing else.
